t.E175.agn: In 2016 EFSA did not set an ADI; it recommended that particle size and the nano fraction be specified in the purity criteria.
t.E175.body: Gold is very poorly soluble; its uptake into the body and its effects are expected to be low.
t.E175.prod: A metal obtained from ore by mechanical separation, or by dissolving with cyanide followed by electrolytic refining; also obtained as a by-product of copper and nickel refining.
t.E175.regx.0: No ADI set; a particle size criterion was recommended.
t.E175.summary: Metallic gold; gives a gold colour as leaf. Used in cake decorations, confectionery and some liqueurs.
